video_route.decision: Use approved still-atlas generation and deterministic cropping; do not claim image-to-video animation.

shared_style.finish: thick impasto oil painting with visible hand-painted brushwork and restrained winter colors
shared_style.adult_proportions: approximately 7 to 7.5 heads tall, natural head and hand size, clearly proportioned legs
shared_style.nonhuman_exception: preserve believable species and age proportions
shared_style.identity_rule: character references constrain identity and clothing; style references constrain finish only

portrait_workflow.layout: single-character 2x2 atlas: Calm, Sad, Intense, Wry

gameplay_sheet_workflow.layout: 12 columns x 3 directions, 72x112 frame, 864x336 sheet, pivot (36,108)
gameplay_sheet_workflow.processing: process_character_atlas.py applies alpha hygiene, common scale and foot anchor

partner_workflow.layout: single-character 2x2 transparent master atlas plus two 2x2 walk-cycle plates combined into Walk0..Walk7
partner_workflow.processing: process_partner_atlas.py preserves the existing target dimensions and aligns feet; process_partner_walkcycle_pair.py exports eight ordered, baseline-aligned frames

provenance_rule: Keep prompts, identity references, raw output, processed output and QA records under this dated run. Replace only existing runtime paths unless an added asset is explicitly referenced.
